changes: Replaced: Sic Bo removed, Plinko added in its place. 8-row peg board, 9 payout slots, same felt/rail table, chip stacking, and croupier lines as the rest of the casino. The multiplier curve is computed from the real binomial probability of a peg board (a genuine random walk, not a made-up curve) and verified to a real 97% RTP — edge slots pay 27.59x, the middle slots pay below 1x, so landing near the centre is a genuine loss, same tension as a real Plinko board.

Fixed along the way: Big Wheel's bet grid quietly depended on Sic Bo's CSS classes and a shared chip-formatting helper — both renamed to neutral, standalone names instead of being deleted outright, so Big Wheel wasn't broken by Sic Bo's removal.
